plugin.name: Fusion Fix
WFP_PLUGINS_DESCRIPTION: The settings of the Fusion Fix and the other plugins
WFP_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Left and right switch between the parts of this page
menu.presethelp: Left and right pick a preset, Enter twice applies it. Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything on
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Press Enter twice to set this page's settings to their defaults
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted in order to apply settings.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies gameplay field of view, which already widens with the screen (Hor-plus). Menus and in-engine cutscenes keep their framing.
hudaspect.description: Auto keeps the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape; 4:3 is the original layout.
cutsceneborders.description: Letterbox keeps the black bars above and below in-engine cutscenes; Pillarbox limits them to their original 4:3 picture.
fmv.description: Original shows the movies as the game does, with their black bars. Fill Screen enlarges them past the black bars around the picture until the picture fits the screen, without cutting anything off.
windowed.description: Full screen, a borderless window or a window with a frame, at the resolution of the game's Screen Configuration.
resx.description: Overrides the resolution picked in the game's Screen Configuration. 0 uses the game's choice.
resy.description: Overrides the resolution picked in the game's Screen Configuration. 0 uses the game's choice.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the Ubisoft, Darkworks and RenderWare startup logos. Story movies remain available. Takes effect when the game starts.
confinecursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu. Automatic uses English. Reopen the menu after changing it.
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses and goes silent while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
menu.detailsnav: Left/right: page. Back: return to settings.
SkipPressStart.description: Go directly from the title prompt to the main menu. Language selection and other choices stay available.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Slide cinematic borders in and out over a quarter of a second. Turn off for instant borders.
